svg.title: LLM Music Lens
svg.desc: Pixel-art night scene: a speaker pulses on every beat and sends small sound arcs into a monitor that shows a piano roll; a red playhead sweeps across at 120 BPM, beat ticks flash, notes light up as it passes and the chords C, Am, F and G appear bar by bar. The portfolio owner stands in front of the monitor; Claude nods along in headphones and Codex taps the beat.
